prompt:
Fix snippets/low-carbon-shipping-flag-3.liquid, which decides whether to show a low-carbon shipping flag. All matching must be exact and case-sensitive. Inputs (all top-level variables, always supplied): - product_tags: array of strings, or null (null behaves like an empty array). - carrier_code: string or null. - offset_percent: integer or null. - badge_label: string or null. Rules: 1. Exempt: if any element of product_tags is exactly the string carbon-exempt (case-sensitive, no trimming; substrings like not-carbon-exempt or variants like Carbon-Exempt do NOT count), output nothing. Exemption overrides every other rule. 2. Tag match: any element of product_tags is exactly low-carbon (case-sensitive, no trimming; Low-Carbon, " low-carbon" and low-carbon-pack do NOT match). 3. Carrier match: carrier_code is exactly ECO or exactly RAIL (case-sensitive; eco, Rail etc. do not match). 4. If neither tag match nor carrier match, output nothing. 5. Otherwise output exactly:

LABELOFFSET

- SOURCE is tag when the tag match holds (even if the carrier also matches), otherwise carrier. - LABEL is badge_label stripped of leading/trailing whitespace and HTML-escaped; if badge_label is null or empty after stripping, LABEL is Low-carbon shipping. - OFFSET is N% offset only when offset_percent is not null and greater than 0, where N is offset_percent capped at 100 (values above 100 display as 100). Otherwise OFFSET is nothing. 6. No whitespace or newlines around or between tags. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/low-carbon-shipping-flag-3.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
